ActorTalk: You know what... I can't stop thinking about that scene of Simon repairing the cabin.
Oh? But isn't your diary covered with nothing but Commandant's photos?

That's different! Commandant has this... natural aura that makes you want to follow them. Senior Simon on the other hand... did you see how he kept working on those circuits even after getting hurt? Watching someone that frail, their hands trembling and all...
So you're falling for someone else?

That's not it! I'm just... appreciating different types of beauty at the same time. Commandant makes me want to grow stronger, but when it comes to Senior Simon, I just want to protect him. No one says these two kinds of attraction can't coexist!
